Package com.nexuslink.protocol.redis

package com.nexuslink.protocol.redis
  • Class
    Description
    RedisCommandCatalog
    A curated, dependency-free catalog of common Redis commands with light metadata, plus a case-insensitive prefix matcher that backs the command console's auto-complete.
    RedisCommandCatalog.Command
    A single catalog entry.
    RedisCommandLine
    Splits a console command line into the argument list Redis expects, the way redis-cli does: whitespace separates arguments, but a double- or single-quoted run is one argument, and inside double quotes \\n, \\t, \\" and \\xNN are unescaped.
    RedisCommandLine.RedisCommandLineException
    Thrown when a command line cannot be split — an unbalanced quote.
    RedisExplorer
    Exposes a connected RedisService as a flat list of keys; selecting a key lazily loads its type, TTL and (typed) value into the details panel.
    RedisGlob
    The glob-style pattern matching Redis uses for KEYS / SCAN MATCH, implemented client-side so listings can be filtered without a round-trip.
    RedisMessage
    A message delivered to a Pub/Sub subscriber.
    RedisMessageLog
    A bounded, thread-safe log of delivered Pub/Sub messages — the model behind the Redis Pub/Sub panel.
    RedisMessageLog.Entry
    One delivered message, stamped on arrival.
    RedisPubSubEvent
    A decoded Redis Pub/Sub push frame: either a delivered RedisMessage or a RedisSubscriptionEvent confirmation.
    RedisReplyOutput
    Collects any Redis reply into plain Java objects — the output the console needs to send a command the client has never heard of and still print what came back.
    RedisServerInfo
    What the server says it is, parsed from the INFO server reply: which product (Redis, Valkey, KeyDB, Dragonfly…), which version, and which mode (standalone, cluster or sentinel).
    RedisService
    Redis client over Lettuce.
    RedisSubscriber
    A Redis Pub/Sub subscriber over a dedicated raw-socket connection, built purely on the hand-rolled RespCodec (no external Redis client library).
    RedisSubscriptionEvent
    A subscription-state confirmation pushed by the server in reply to SUBSCRIBE/UNSUBSCRIBE/PSUBSCRIBE/PUNSUBSCRIBE.
    RedisSubscriptionEvent.Kind
    The kind of subscription change reported.
    RedisTopology
    The deployment shape behind a connection URI.
    RespCodec
    A dependency-free (JDK-only) codec for the Redis Serialization Protocol.
    RespException
    Thrown when a RESP payload is malformed or cannot be encoded/decoded.
    RespIncompleteException
    Signals that the input ended before a full RESP reply could be decoded — i.e.
    RespValue
    A decoded RESP (Redis Serialization Protocol) value.
    RespValue.BigNumber
    RESP3 big number (3492890328409238509324850943850943825024385\r\n.
    RespValue.BulkError
    RESP3 bulk error !21\r\nSYNTAX invalid syntax\r\n.
    RespValue.BulkString
    RESP2 $5\r\nhello\r\n, or the null bulk $-1\r\n when RespValue.BulkString.bytes() is null.
    RespValue.RespArray
    RESP2 *2\r\n..., or the null array *-1\r\n when RespValue.RespArray.items() is null.
    RespValue.RespBoolean
    RESP3 boolean #t\r\n / #f\r\n.
    RespValue.RespDouble
    RESP3 double ,3.14\r\n (also ,inf, ,-inf, ,nan).
    RespValue.RespError
    RESP2 -ERR message\r\n.
    RespValue.RespInteger
    RESP2 :123\r\n.
    RespValue.RespMap
    RESP3 map %2\r\n....
    RespValue.RespNull
    RESP3 null _\r\n.
    RespValue.RespPush
    RESP3 push >2\r\n... (out-of-band pub/sub style messages).
    RespValue.RespSet
    RESP3 set ~2\r\n....
    RespValue.SimpleString
    RESP2 +OK\r\n.
    RespValue.VerbatimString
    RESP3 verbatim string =15\r\ntxt:Some string\r\n: a 3-char format tag plus text.
